Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.

payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image depict the source image as a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: assess whether the depicted source content is actually rendered in a chalk-drawing visual form across the scene, rather than merely receiving a chalk-like texture or overlay. Judge the extent of the content rendered as chalk: a scene-wide chalk-made rendering is complete; a concrete chalk treatment that leaves substantial depicted content photographic is partial.
node.binding: SOURCE is the image to transform; EDITED must show that same image rendered as a chalk drawing. Evaluate the rendering of the source scene and its depicted content, not texture alone.
node.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
node.endpoint: The source image is rendered as a chalk-made drawing.
node.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
node.zero_when: The edited image shows no requested chalk-drawing transformation of the source image; unrelated edits or a texture overlay without chalk rendering of depicted content do not count.
node.half_when: The source image has a concrete chalk-drawing treatment, but substantial depicted content still reads as photographic rather than being rendered as chalk. A broad chalk-like overlay or texture alone does not make the transformation complete.
node.full_when: The edited image presents the source image’s depicted content across the scene as a drawing made from chalk, allowing natural variation in lighting, texture, and photographic detail; photographic detail may remain, but the scene should genuinely read as a chalk-made drawing rather than merely having a chalk-like overlay or texture.

node_traces.evidence: The same two giraffes and surrounding scene are rendered with a distinctly drawn, soft, grainy chalk-like appearance: edges are sketched, colors are muted and blended, and the background vegetation and ground are broadly reinterpreted rather than simply covered with texture. Some photographic-looking detail remains, especially in the giraffes’ patterned bodies and parts of their contours, so the scene does not read as uniformly chalk-made throughout. This is a substantial but not fully complete chalk-drawing transformation.
